ana-finance: Acquirer flagged acct_7720 for a chargeback claim: cardholder says multiple small authorizations then three large captures. Bank put a temporary hold on settlement. Need evidence + quick recommendation.

rob-payments: Can you paste the tx ids and timeframe? Ill grab auth/capture chain and AVS.

ana-finance: TX-1122, TX-1123, TX-1125. Window: 2026-03-21 23:45-00:05 UTC. Total $3,150. Billing contact billing@neoapps.io.

fraud-bot: ALERT: fraud_score=0.91, pattern=card_testing_then_capture, repeats=4 accounts in 48h, device_fingerprint_new=TRUE, ip_pool=RESIDENTIAL_VPN. Recommend HOLD + EVIDENCE_SUBMIT.

rob-payments: Quick snippet:
```
mask_pan,txn_id,amount,auth_country,auth_code
**** **** **** 2222,TX-1122,450,US,AUTH90
**** **** **** 2222,TX-1123,1200,US,AUTH91
**** **** **** 2222,TX-1125,1500,US,AUTH93
```
Uploading logs to secure S3 now.

maks-cs: Customer says they didnt initiate these and opened a bank dispute. They want refund asap.

jules-legal: Before sending bundle: redact PAN, include timeline, invoices, subscription history, login IPs, and any 2FA events. Do not include CVV. Confirm TOS has consent to log IPs.

rob-payments: Uploaded evidence: https://internal-s3/redwood/chargebacks/1902502468/evidence_bundle.zip (restricted). Bundle contains invoices/, session_logs.csv, ip_list.csv, auth_chain.json (redacted).

ana-finance: Notes: account shows multiple short failed authorizations earlier (00:10-00:20 UTC) consistent with testing. Login last seen 03-20; spike of model runs at 23:50 for long-running batch.

fraud-bot: Supplemental signal: same IP subnet used to create two new accounts that processed micro auths earlier today. Correlation id=CR-3342.

rob-payments: My recommendation: contest representment and submit the evidence bundle. Given card-testing history and VPN IPs, our probability of winning is moderate. Keep payout hold.

maks-cs: Customer refusing to pause dispute. They asked for a chargeback reversal if we cant prove authorization.

jules-legal: We should not issue refund until representment outcome unless customer agrees to withdraw dispute in writing. Approve evidence submit.

ana-finance: Plan: 1) Submit representment today with the redacted bundle. 2) Maintain payout hold. 3) Offer conditional courtesy credit of $600 only if customer sends written withdrawal of dispute. Approve?

rob-payments: Submitting to issuer now, will post confirmation id.

fraud-bot: Case logged CB-2026-7720.

ana-finance: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with any bank replies or customer notes.
